_comment: Teaching content for this game's notes page. make-notes.py builds pedagogical-notes.html from this and README.md. 'by' says whose idea it is (todd or claude); it is never shown on the page.
practice: Building words from a limited rack of letters.
Deciding whether to spend a tile now or save it for a longer word: each tile can be used once in the whole round.
Reasoning about which letters are likely, in a Wheel of Fortune style rescue puzzle.
Finding every word hidden in the same letters (TEA, EAT, ATE, SEAT) in the bonus round, then seeing the longest words they missed.
thinking: Planning with scarce resources. Scrabble scoring rewards rare letters, so a student has to weigh a sure word now against a better one later, and the rack carries over from level to level.

considering.text: A teacher's own word list, so the spelling round uses a unit's vocabulary.
Showing the best possible word after each round, as a learning moment.
